name: Baku
description: A composite chimera-like creature originating in Chinese mythology (mò 貘) and adopted into Japanese folklore (baku 獏) by the Muromachi period, traditionally invoked to consume nightmares and protect sleepers. The same Sino-Japanese word now also denotes the tapir.

aliases.name: 獏 / 貘
aliases.meaning: Mythological dream-eating creature; also the modern word for 'tapir'

aliases.name: Mò
aliases.meaning: Original Chinese name of the creature

aliases.name: Dream-eater
aliases.meaning: Common Anglophone gloss for the creature

origin: Originating in Chinese mythological tradition (mò 貘) and adopted into Japanese folklore by the Muromachi period; later transmitted across the Sinosphere and globally via popular culture.
